acknowledged.thm:sparse-beyond-birthday: Delivered headline result: at zero density the CR2 estimator is ratio-consistent under N_n/n -> 0 with no N_n^2/n condition. It is one of the paper's contributions, not an input to another statement, so nothing consumes it.
acknowledged.thm:qv-diagonal-impossibility: Delivered headline result: the positive-density lower bound showing no one-realization statistic is uniformly ratio-consistent for the exact variance over the dense bounded-schedule class. A terminal contribution by construction.
acknowledged.prop:clubsandwich-consumer: Delivered benchmark: identifies the paper's scalar CR2 statistic with the equal-group clubSandwich::vcovCR(type='CR2') call, which is what makes the theory actionable for practitioners. Terminal by design.
acknowledged.prop:eight-unit-witness: Delivered benchmark: the exhaustively enumerated n=8, M=2, G=4 design with exact variance 1/7 and expected CR2 2/7, the concrete check on the finite-sample formulas. Terminal by design.
acknowledged.def:eight-unit-witness: The design object the eight-unit benchmark evaluates; consumed by prop:eight-unit-witness in the paper's prose and proof, though the frozen statement graph carries no statement-uses edge for it.
acknowledged.lem:classical-kneser-spectrum: Stated external input, not motivation: the classical normalized Kneser eigenvalue lambda_{n,k} = (-1)^k (M)_k/(n-M)_k is the hypothesis package thm:exact-kneser-identity runs on. The frozen theorem spells that hypothesis out inline rather than \cref-ing the lemma, which is why the statement graph shows no consumer; the appendix proof cites it.
acknowledged.lem:classical-johnson-decomposition: Stated external input, not motivation: the classical centered Johnson orthogonal decomposition is the second hypothesis package of thm:exact-kneser-identity and of the projection algebra behind def:dense-correction. Inlined in the frozen theorem's hypotheses, hence no statement-graph edge; the appendix proof cites it.
